page0.text:
By the time we're home, the rain has completely stopped.
...I've been holding hands with Sakura since we left the park.
She calmed down while we were walking, and we began to get embarrassed as we went up the hill path, but we didn't stop holding hands until we got home.

page1.text:
"Huh...? The lights are on. Sakura, did you come back here earlier?"
"...Um, I don't think that was me. Maybe it's Ms. Fujimura...?"

page2.text:
"Yeah."
That could be it. I head for the door, taking Sakura with me.
Her hand was freezing cold, but now it's incredibly warm.
I feel reassured by the life I feel flowing through her veins, and go inside like I would if I just got home from school.

page3.text: "Welcome back. Sorry to intrude, but I made myself at home."

page5.text: "Yeah. I decided to check here as a last resort, but I didn't think you'd come back together... Though there was always a chance, knowing you, Emiya."

page6.text:
"...!"
I gasp and push Sakura behind me, facing Tohsaka squarely.

page7.text:
"Tohsaka, you still...!"
"Of course. As a Tohsaka mage, I can't let Sakura Matou go. If I don't execute her as the administrator of Fuyuki, I'll draw the ire of the Association. It'll be too late once that happens."

page8.text:
"That's your problem. Sakura still hasn't done anything wrong. If you're going to hurt her, then you'll have to go through me."
"I bet. You're a free mage who isn't affiliated with the Association, so it would be better if I tied up that loose end, too.
I'm going to kill Sakura. If you get in my way, I'll kill you, too."

page9.text:
"..."
My nerves stand on edge.
Tohsaka's fingertips.
If they so much as twitch, that will be the opening shot.

page10.text:
I have to get Sakura outside before Tohsaka finishes an incantation.
After that...I'll just have to figure it out as we go.
Right now, I concentrate on how we're going to get out of here.
There's a huge disparity in our magical skills.
Archer's probably around, too, and I have no idea how to deal with him.

page11.text:
...
Tohsaka's lips move slightly.
Just as I realize that she's about to talk instead of cast a spell...
"Stop! Please stop, Nee-san!"
Sakura puts herself between us.

page12.text:
"...Sakura."
"S-Senpai is right. He's the only person I've hurt so far. If he's willing to forgive me, then I shouldn't be punished."

page13.text:
"...Do you really understand what's happening to your body right now?
You've got some nerve to say that."
"...I mean it. I'm still all right.
What about you, Tohsaka-senpai? Senpai isn't a Master anymore, but you still are. He's back to how he was now that Saber is gone, and you're still going to attack him?"

page14.text: "Yeah. It doesn't even matter if he's unarmed. If he gets in my way, then I can't show him any mercy."

page15.text:
"Then...if you're going to fight him, then I'll fight you too. I won't lose to you, as Rider's Master."
Sakura's scared, but she faces Tohsaka with all her courage.

page16.text:
...
...Is Tohsaka surprised by Sakura's grit, or does she think she's at a disadvantage?
"Fine. If you really mean that, then win this war. That's the only way to save you.
If you have the Holy Grail, then you can easily free yourself from Zouken's shackles."

page17.text:
"Uh...Tohsaka-senpai?"
"I'm not just going to let you go.
If we're both competing for the Holy Grail, then we're bound to end up fighting. This just isn't the right place for it."

page18.text:
She walks by us.
Without any hostility or bloodlust, Tohsaka pushes past us with surprising grace.

page19.text:
"Tohsaka."
"Hmph. Our united front lasted all of one day. Can't really call this an alliance anymore, if you're going to protect Sakura."
...

page20.text:
"But don't forget. We don't know when she'll lose control again.
You can get yourself killed if you want...but she's your responsibility now, so make sure you're the only victim."
She leaves without looking back.

page21.text:
"...Senpai, um. I..."
"Don't look so worried, stupid. That's just Tohsaka's way of being sarcastic. She teases people for fun."
"..."

page22.text:
I give the sad girl a little push and go into the hallway.
We're both freezing, so we need to change and get warm.

page23.text: "She's your responsibility now, so make sure you're the only victim."

page24.text:
She means that I need to take Sakura down with me, if she kills me.
That was the minimum condition Tohsaka laid down when she left.
"..."
...It won't happen.
I tell myself that while I take Sakura to the living room.

page25.text:
...Her hand feels so warm.
Sakura's alive, and she's here.
That's all I care about now.
I can't let other doubts plague me and make Sakura more worried, but...

page26.text:
"...Mm?"
Hold on.
Her hand is too warm.

page27.text:
"Sakura. Is your fever back?"
"Huh...? U-um, I'm not sure. Do I feel hot?"
Sakura says something strange, like she hasn't even noticed.

page28.text:
"Not really, but you're still warmer than I am. It's like I feel all warm and fuzzy just by touching you."
"Ah...i-it must be a cold! I think I caught a cold because I was out in the rain for such a long time!"
?
Sakura suddenly looks away bashfully, for some reason.

page29.text: "Oh. Yeah, you were. You'd better get changed and warm up. I'll make dinner, so go take your temperature, and if you have a cold, wear something warm in the living room. I'll make something easy to eat."

page30.text:
"Ah... N-no, I don't need dinner. Um, I'm going to sleep now, so you should rest too!"
She half runs away.

page31.text:
"???"
...Well, okay.
I'll catch a cold if I stay like this too, so I'd better warm up in the bath.
